public_API.audit_pair: audit_pair(work, plan, slots, fold_manifest, deadline_monotonic=None): exactly one fold with a/b slots, quality only after both sealed-complete and terminal-owned-clean; returns arms, bindings, prefix parity, mandatory_fold_gates_passed, violated_gates, mechanism telemetry.
public_API.audit_complete_oof: audit_complete_oof(work, plan, slots, fold_manifest, deadline_monotonic=None): all6 declared slots retained; incomplete/technical failure keeps aggregate metrics null; ALL3 audited valid pairs needed for any full-CV mean/pooled/OOF and positive qualification.
public_API.fail_closed: Raises AuditError with a fixed descriptive code for inconsistent/unsealed/running/missing mandatory evidence; does not guess paths, read private ledgers, signal processes, fit or call an API.

plan_contract.manifest: Root-reviewed frozen external-supervisor manifest object, plus manifest_path and exact manifest_sha256.
plan_contract.verifier_source_sha256: Exact current independent module bytes must be pinned in manifest/plan before use.
plan_contract.r3_protocol_and_publication_receipt: Path/SHA references equal fixed published bindings.
plan_contract.archives: a/b path/SHA refs equal exact A88dac/Bd514 candidates.
plan_contract.common_absolute_deadline_unix_and_common: Finite original prospective stage deadline; each saved clock and every audit stay inside it.
plan_contract.stage_receipt_path: Bound stage matrix receipt; no standalone launch is authorized by this module.

slot_contract.identity: fold0..2, arm a/b, status; all6 declaration slots always retained.
slot_contract.successful_pair_required: status=sealed_complete, exit_code0, cleanup_confirmed=true, output_dir/work-relative, report_path, source_archive_sha256, known exact command argv, solver full refit/integrity/source/input evidence.
slot_contract.supervisor: Owned root and complete observed exact PID/create_time identities; cleanup observation receipt bound by SHA. Same-identity live or AccessDenied invalid; PID reuse ignored; never signal any PID.
slot_contract.seal: {root:output_dir, files_sha256:{relative file:SHA256}, sealed_unix:finite}. seal_sha256 is SHA256 of canonical JSON (sort_keys,compact separators,ensure_ascii=false,allow_nan=false). Every artifact the verifier reads must be sealed and hash-correct. Private run-budget trace directories are explicitly excluded and never read.
slot_contract.technical_failure: Whole-arm watchdog/missing mandatory final export/resource/integrity/source/cleanup invalidity can fail qualification without reading pair truth. Handled failed student experiments inside a valid whole arm are retained as status/null, not automatically arm-invalid.
slot_contract.unattempted: not_attempted_due_prior_gate_failure with null metrics/refit/prediction fields and decisive audit binding; never omit/impute.

independent_checks: Verify fixed publication/protocol/fold/source/archive/input hashes and exact source+five deployed files in each solver root.
BOTH arms sealed+terminal cleanup before raw outer truth read or any fold quality scoring.
Stream pristine labels/IDs; verify actual saved outer fold arrays, raw-feature group disjointness/coverage/support and A/B equal local fitting/test inputs.

Final fresh refit result/job/selected recipe/median nested iterations; recursively reconstruct original two-view and fixed four-view leaves and global probability mixtures; class/row/ID/schema/argmax CSV equivalence.
Compare first11 experiment index/order/recipe/status/failure-null, actual inner split arrays/groups and available canonical probabilities/predictions/metrics; omit only paths/timing from parity.
MacroF1/perclass/ex-rarest from pristine outer labels, supported>=100 independent fitting-group deltas>=-.01, strict positive MacroF1/ex-rarest eachfold.
Only all3 valid folds/all6 arms may yield full fold mean, pooled MacroF1 and exactly-once OOF; every original r3 gate applies. No one-fold nonselection early rejection.
API0 source+--offline --max-llm-calls0+report evidence is separate from unavailable private closed-ledger/provider evidence, which stays null.
limits: Preparation has no existing CV outcome reads, scoring, tests, fitting or API calls. AST-only syntax check allowed.
Supervisor/source gates/fresh cleanup/released lock/frozen deadline/root review still required before future execution.
Raw private ledgers are never read, queried for ACLs or bypassed.
Pure saved-artifact metrics are exploratory reused-public development evidence, not private/official score or provider billing.
